_comment: The LM's malfunction procedures for the failure catalog's LM failures (data/failures.json, slice 9e), in every LM checklist book after its flight's lists (ChecklistBook.load_lm()). A failure opens its procedure as it comes. The simulator's own [adapted]: each light's meaning is the LM caution and warning table's (LM Apollo Operations Handbook, LMA790-3-LM, section 2.9.4) [published]; the actions are those the simulated systems have. The aborts: ABORT fires P70 on the descent engine, ABORT STAGE stages and fires P71 on the ascent engine, each whatever ENG ARM says (ibid., section 2.1) [published].

steps.text: DES REG: the descent tanks' helium out of limits (the HUD's LM C&W line); the descent engine's thrust dies away
In the powered descent: ABORT STAGE - press: staged, P71 on the ascent engine
LGC MODE - AUTO: the LGC steers to insertion; at cutoff V16N85, PRO

checklists.title: Malfunction: RCS A or B REG

steps.text: RCS A REG or RCS B REG: a system's helium regulator out of limits; its jets are lost
RCS SYS A (or B) - CLOSE, the failed system's main shutoff valves: its light goes out, and the LM flies on the other
LGC or ISS: the PGNS's computer or its platform has failed
GUID CONT - AGS: the AGS holds the attitude, and the light goes out
In the powered descent: an abort on the AGS [the AGS's own insertion guidance isn't modelled]
